name: Diagnosis: Murder
description: Dr. Mark Sloan is a good-natured, offbeat physician who is called upon to solve murders.

videos.title: Diagnosis of Murder
videos.overview: Police detective Steve Sloan believes that top manager Nick Osborn has killed his boss, trust-owner Russell Cord. His father, senior hospital doctor Mark Sloan, is convinced that his long-time patient Osborn is innocent and soon discovers three other top employees of the Cord Group who also had reasons for killing their boss.

videos.title: The House on Sycamore Street
videos.overview: Dr Mark Sloan cannot believe that his former student Dr Drummond, an ambitious cosmetic surgeon, has committed suicide. Assisted by his team of hobby detectives, pathologist Amanda Bentley and junior doctor Jack Parker, Sloan tries to investigate the case.

videos.title: A Twist of the Knife
videos.overview: Dr Sloan suspects that his flame of long ago, famous heart surgeon Dr Rachel Walters, has murdered US Senator Cabot on the occasion of a guest operation at the community hospital.

videos.title: Town Without Pity
videos.overview: In Los Rios enroute to Los Angeles, Carol makes an urgent call to her father, Dr. Mark Sloan, pleading for help. Arriving in the small, seemingly pleasant mountain town, Mark investigates but the whole community denies knowing anything about his daughter and her husband.

videos.title: Without Warning
videos.overview: Dr. Mark Sloan (Dick Van Dyke) reprises his role as the crime solving doctor in this tv movie based on the television series. When a large group of Mexican workers are infected with a deadly virus, Dr. Sloan and his friends must figure out the cause and cure for it before it's too late.

videos.title: Miracle Cure
videos.overview: A priest kills his would-be blackmailers and does everything he can to cover his tracks. Dr. Sloan investigates when details don't quite add up.

videos.title: Amnesia
videos.overview: Security is increased at the hospital when Senator Robert Bassett undergoes an operation. Drs. Sloan and Stewart are preoccupied when a beautiful young amnesia patient is brought in. Unbeknownst to them, their beautiful young patient is a professional killer.

videos.title: Murder at the Telethon
videos.overview: When an abrasive, washed-up comic is found dead at a Community General benefit telethon, suspicion is cast on everyone from his son to his former writers.

videos.title: Inheritance of Death
videos.overview: Mark's cousin, Jonathan Nash, bequeaths his million-dollar fortune to Community General Hospital. His three dastardly children are the main suspects after Nash dies suspiciously... before he has a chance to alter his will.

videos.title: The 13 Million Dollar Man
videos.overview: After a dying man gives Dr. Sloane a winning lottery ticket, the deceased's family and creditors swarm him, claiming the ticket is theirs.

videos.title: Vanishing Act (1)
videos.overview: A group of crooked cops frame Steve for murder after he gets too close to their robbery operation. Jack visits some past friends, now mobsters, to dig up information.

videos.title: Vanishing Act (2)
videos.overview: The same gang involved in the Schroeder murder kidnaps Mark's underworld friend, Gus Benedict. Jack and Mark try to save Benedict before time runs out.

videos.title: Shanda's Song
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan treats a famous singer,then takes her into his home as a homicidal closes in.

videos.title: The Restless Remains
videos.overview: Financier Robin westlin dies in Dr. Sloan's house, but when the paramedics at the scene, the body's gone. Everyone is certain the event was a figment of Mark's imagination. Dr. Sloan goes on a quest to validate his theory.

videos.title: Murder with Mirrors
videos.overview: A team of Magicians Clark & Madison, breaks up when Paul Madison decides to go solo.  Mark jumps to his friend Clark's aid when Madison turns up dead with Eddie Clark the main suspect.

videos.title: Flashdance with Death
videos.overview: Steve's latest girlfriend, a dance instructor, is a suspect in a murder investigation when a dance club's owner dies mysteriously.

videos.title: Reunion with Murder
videos.overview: A tell-all book written by one of Amanda's vindictive old college roommates contains embarrassing secrets of all four roommates. Dr. Sloan tries to discover what happened when the author is found dead and Amanda is the main suspect.

videos.title: Lily
videos.overview: A prostitute, who tells Jack of her plans to blackmail her clients, is found dead of an apparent drug overdose. Dr. Sloan interviews her clients to discover the real cause of death.

videos.title: Guardian Angel
videos.overview: An unhappy politician's wife guns down her husband in an underground garage. Mark sees through her alibi and attempts to confirm his suspicions.

videos.title: Nirvana
videos.overview: Chet Brooks, one of Jack's old friends, shows up on the run from gamblers, begging for help. Jack reluctantly loans Chet his car, only to have Chet and the car explode in a fiery wreck. Jack tangles with the underworld to find out what happened.

videos.title: Broadcast Blues
videos.overview: A convict, being treated at County General, manages to take a hostage and demand news coverage. When the newscaster covering the event is shot down, Dr. Sloan takes it upon himself to figure out what went wrong.

videos.title: Shaker
videos.overview: A Los Angeles earthquake apparently causes an armoire to topple over on top of a good friend of Dr. Sloan's, Martin Garfield, killing him. The dry-eyed Sloan goes to work and discovers that Garfield may have been killed before the earthquake. Jack and Amanda help Mark weed through the wealthy family to find the murderer.

videos.title: The Plague
videos.overview: A gangland 'protector' under surveillance by Steve becomes infected with the plague when a medicine bottle is mysteriously switched. Dr. Sloan tries to find the source of the virus before the murderer starts an epidemic.

videos.title: Sister Michael Wants You
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan goes undercover at a convent when mysterious circumstances surround a murder.

videos.title: Many Happy Returns
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan is under suspicion after his tax preparer is killed with Mark spotted 'hovering' over the body.

videos.title: A Very Fatal Funeral
videos.overview: Suspicion is cast on Norman Briggs after the chairman of a philanthropical medical group of which Norman is a part, is murdered. Steve and Mark attend the funeral to nail the culprit, who promptly falls over dead.

videos.title: Woman Trouble
videos.overview: Two women involved in a love triangle plot to murder a man, take his millions, and leave the country. Dr. Sloan investigates after his friend's mysterious disappearence.

videos.title: The Busy Body
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan's birthday is less than festive when he discovers the body of a prominent divorce lawyer in the Hospital pharmacy. When Steve arrives, the body is nowhere to be found. Mark and Jack work feverishly to find the body, find the culprit, and lead a tour of potential investors all at the same time.

videos.title: My Four Husbands
videos.overview: A famous actress, a patient at Community General, is implicated in the murder of one of her four ex-husbands. Against everyone's advice, Mark believes in her innocence and sets out to prove it.

videos.title: Murder Most Vial
videos.overview: A cantankerous patient at Community General is given a double injection of his medication, eventually leading to his death. Jack suspects a doctor he's had a grudge against for a long time. Despite Mark's objections, Jack sets out to prove his ""enemy"" is the killer.

videos.title: You Can Call Me Johnson
videos.overview: At Jack's request, Mark operates on a Godfather-like mobster, Albert Bartell... and faces retribution from the man's son when Albert dies suddenly.

videos.title: Georgia on My Mind
videos.overview: Jack and Steve vie for a young woman's affections as she leads them in an investigation of a PI's death.

videos.title: The Last Laugh (1)
videos.overview: A plastic surgeon dies due to an overdose of laughing gas... with no shortage of suspects. Mark campaigns furiously to exonerate Bonnie Valin, the victim's wife, while Steve makes a solid case against her. Meanwhile, Amanda's new electronic checking service is less than effective.

videos.title: The Last Laugh (2)
videos.overview: Realizing that he's been duped, Mark goes all out to thwart the murderer's plans. Amanda and Jack go after Wallace Sterling, the crooked financier and art lover by selling a forged painting of a can of Cream of Celery soup.

videos.title: Death By Extermination
videos.overview: The body of a dead real estate agent is found in the walk-in closet of Mark's sister's new house. Mark and Steve have to work around Dora Sloan's annoying habits while investigating the murder.

videos.title: Standing Eight Count
videos.overview: The newly crowned boxing champion is found murdered shortly after the bout. Jack and Amanda investigate the deceased's former trainer, his opponent, and his opponent's manager to find a way through a web of lies and deceit.

videos.title: The Bela Lugosi Blues
videos.overview: Mark has some unorthodox theories when several dead bodies are found drained of blood with puncture marks on their neck.

videos.title: The New Healers
videos.overview: When an unpopular actor on a hot new medical drama (being filmed at Community General) suddenly dies, Mark suspects everyone from the writer to other cast members.

videos.title: Call Me Incontestable
videos.overview: A rash of murders made to look like suicide leads to a dating service and its beautiful customers.

videos.title: A Blast From the Past
videos.overview: One of Steve's old ""collars"" gets out of prison and comes looking for revenge.

videos.title: Playing for Keeps
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan investigates the murder of an antagonistic pro volleyball player. Steve searches for an alleged stalker while Amanda and Jack keep an eye on her teammates, none of whom are particularly upset over her death.

videos.title: Sea No Evil
videos.overview: IRS Agent Gretchen McCord returns when her lifeguard nephew is accused of murder.

videos.title: How to Murder Your Lawyer
videos.overview: After Steve's night school law teacher is nearly run down in the parking lot, he and a paralegal investigate shady dealings in their law firm.

videos.title: Naked Babes
videos.overview: When Amanda's friend Angela is kidnapped immediately after giving birth to quadruplets, Amanda feigns pregnancy and goes undercover at an adoption agency to locate Angela. Jack and Dr. Sloan try to care for the babies.

videos.title: Death in the Daytime
videos.overview: Amanda wins a guest role on The Young and the Restless and walks right into a murder.

videos.title: My Baby is Out of this World
videos.overview: The death of a popular musician raises suspicious questions. The musicians' pregnant wife, who claims to be carrying an alien's child, complicates matters.

videos.title: An Innocent Murder
videos.overview: Ashley York murders her wealthy father and cleverly manipulates it to appear as though he killed himself. Dr. Sloan picks away at holes in the story, which leads him directly to Ashley.

videos.title: Witness to Murder
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan takes in an abandoned young girl found at the scene of a murder, while Steve and Jesse go about tracking down the killer.

videos.title: All-American Murder
videos.overview: The murder of a beautiful woman around a marine encampment raises suspicions. Dr. Sloan discovers more to her than meets the eye.

videos.title: Murder in the Courthouse
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan suspects a cunning D.A. in the murder of an acquited defendant.

videos.title: Murder on the Run (1)
videos.overview: A man wrongfully convicted of murder takes Dr. Sloan hostage. Dr. Sloan hears his story and works to prove the man's innocence. Jesse works feverishly to rescue Mark.

videos.title: Murder on the Run (2)
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan shields George Karn from both Steve and Lt. Delaney while investigating his wife's murder.

videos.title: Love is Murder
videos.overview: Steve heads up the investigation when a serial cop killer is on the prowl, while inadvertantly dating the killer.

videos.title: Misdiagnosis Murder
videos.overview: An exhausted Jesse, coming off a 48-hour stint in the hospital, witnesses a man die in the parking garage. Jesse returns with help only to find the man alive. While everyone believes Jesse to have been delirious, Jesse insists he was correct, and goes all out to prove himself.

videos.title: The Pressure to Murder
videos.overview: Amanda's cousin falls to his death when his motorcycle suddenly veers off the road. Amanda leads the investigation when it's discovered her cousin was drugged immediately before the accident.

videos.title: Living on the Streets Can Be Murder
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan investigates a free health clinic after several homeless people turn up dead... with missing organs.

videos.title: Murder Murder
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan tries to solve a friend's murder while Steve investigates the deceased's ex-wife and her identical twin sister.

videos.title: Murder in the Dark
videos.overview: A visiting surgeon must deal with his alcoholism after a fellow doctor is murdered during one of his blackouts.

videos.title: 35 Millimeter Murder
videos.overview: When a photo shop erroneously sends Dr. Sloan the wrong set of photographs, he becomes embroiled in the murder investigation of an escort girl. Meanwhile, Amanda's baby is about to come to term.

videos.title: The Murder Trade
videos.overview: In an episode reminiscent of Hitchcock's 'Strangers on a Train'", Dr. Sloan is drawn into a murder pact by a psychiatrist in need of money. The psychiatrist kills a woman pestering Dr. Sloan, expecting Mark to eliminate his 'problem'".

videos.title: Mind Over Murder
videos.overview: Jesse is attracted to a beautiful psychic, who also happens to be the prime suspect in a murder. Amanda copes with the trials of motherhood.

videos.title: Murder by the Book
videos.overview: The daughter of one of Mark's friends writes a juicy tell-all expose of the most prominent public figures. Mark takes her in after a crazed stalker starts threatening her and her co-authors.

videos.title: FMurder
videos.overview: Mark investigates a perky morning television personalty for the murder of a Howard Stern-like radio host.

videos.title: Left-Handed Murder
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan is the executor of his friend, Preston Michael's, estate after Michaels is found in the body of a shark. Things turn interesting after traces of poison are found in Michaels' body and three women, all apparently married to Michaels, attend the reading of the will.

videos.title: Murder by Friendly Fire
videos.overview: One police officer is accidentally shot by another during a raid gone wrong. Dr. Sloan investigates the victim's wife, the shooter, and a conniving lawyer when he suspects foul play.

videos.title: Murder Can Be Contagious
videos.overview: A burglar inadvertently becomes infected with a deadly virus. Dr. Sloan and Jesse are subsequently exposed to the virus after Jesse stumbles upon the thief's dead body. Both Mark and Jesse are confined to Mark's home while Steve and Amanda investigate the drug company that manufactured the virus, in the hopes of discovering an antidote before Jesse runs out of time.

videos.title: Murder on Thin Ice
videos.overview: A figure skater hires her ex-coach to attack a rival skater. Dr. Sloan tries to prove her guilt.

videos.title: X Marks the Murder (1)
videos.overview: Mark, Steve, et al, investigate a string of the so-called ""Casanova"" murders. Dr. Sloan loses his detached perspective when the killer begins calling Mark.

videos.title: X Marks the Murder (2)
videos.overview: Mark, Steve, et al, investigate a string of the so-called ""Casanova"" murders. Dr. Sloan loses his detached perspective when the killer begins calling Mark.

videos.title: A Model Murder
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan investigates a photographer, the overly protective mother of Jesse's friend's fiancÃ©e, in the murder of a private investigator.

videos.title: Murder Can Be Murder
videos.overview: A respected cardiologist murders an innocent man in an insurance scam. Dr. Sloan reluctantly investigates his friend.

videos.title: An Explosive Murder
videos.overview: A young undercover detective investigates a militia-type organization to solve a terrorist bombing witnessed by Mark. She has to decide whether to risk blowing her cover and warn Dr. Sloan of an attempt on his life or finish her assignment.

videos.title: Murder by the Busload
videos.overview: A bus accident brings multiple victims into the hospital. Amanda does the bulk of the investigating when its discovered that a casualty in the accident was actually murdered.

videos.title: A Candidate for Murder
videos.overview: His scheming advisor covers up the accidental death of the drug-addicted daughter of a U.S. Senator. Dr. Sloan and Amanda investigate.

videos.title: The ABC's of Murder
videos.overview: An ADA sets out on a vendetta against an Asian youth, against both Mark and Steve's advice, after a drive-by shooting at a high school leaves one teacher dead.

videos.title: Murder in the Family
videos.overview: Mark's daughter returns after eight years, leaving an abusive husband who later turns up dead.

videos.title: In Defense of Murder
videos.overview: When a famous prostitute writes a tell-all book, an executive's job at Community General is in serious jeopardy.

videos.title: A History of Murder
videos.overview: Mark investigates a 30-year old murder when the body of his old mentor is discovered entombed in a wall in the hospital.

videos.title: Murder Two (1)
videos.overview: Jesse is arrested and charged with murder after a doctor testifying against Jesse in a malpractice suit is poisoned. Mark convinces his old friend, Ben Matlock, to defend Jesse.

videos.title: Murder Two (2)
videos.overview: Amanda and Ben investigate the murder of Eric Spindler while Jesse continues to languish in jail.

videos.title: Hard-Boiled Murder
videos.overview: Mark aids an old friend, Joe Mannix, in solving a 25-year-old, unsolved murder.

videos.title: Murder, Country Style
videos.overview: When a musician is found murdered at a Country Music Awards ceremony, Dr. Sloan and company rush to find the culprit before the show ends and the crowd disappears.

videos.title: Delusions of Murder
videos.overview: A devious psychologist uses hypnotism to facilitate his criminal acts, including the murder of his wife.

videos.title: A Passion for Murder
videos.overview: An aggressive female pharmaceuticals representative stalks the hospital's new chief of staff after a one-night-stand, hoping to break up his marriage and have him all for herself.

videos.title: Blood Brothers Murder
videos.overview: A beach boy involved with a gang member's sister is suspected of murdering him. Mark investigates.

videos.title: Physician, Murder Thyself
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan investigates when an unpopular colleague drops dead while performing an operation. Mark investigates his fellow doctors when tests reveal the deceased was poisoned.

videos.title: Murder in the Air
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan and Amanda investigate when the co-pilot of the airplance carrying them to a medical conference is murdered and the remainder of the flight crew are incapacitated with a mysterious illness.

videos.title: The Merry Widow Murder
videos.overview: A wealthy woman and her boyfriend dupe Mark and plot to murder her husband.

videos.title: Comedy is Murder
videos.overview: A bungling comedian seeks revenge on his former partner when he's cheated out of millions.

videos.title: The Murder of Mark Sloan
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan is stalked by a mad bomber whom he helped incarcerate. Norman and Mark are the main dissenters in negotiations to sell the hospital to a corporate raider.

videos.title: Murder Blues
videos.overview: Steve becomes embroiled in political intrigue after the murder of a city councilman's wife appears to be part of a larger political strategy. Steve investigates two mayoral candidates, the councilman and the chief of police, as well as a rogue detective and his partner, all with strong motives.

videos.title: Open and Shut
videos.overview: Mark investigates when a teenage girl is murdered after threatening to reveal her affair with her older lover, a newly appointed state Supreme Court Justice.

videos.title: Malibu Fire
videos.overview: A Malibu Hills fire is the backdrop for rising tensions between the residents; a disgraced stockbroker, a naturalist, a worried father, and a land developer. A worried Dr. Sloan deals with his own parental fears when Steve helps fight the fire.

videos.title: Deadly Games
videos.overview: Community General is already under increased security, with a high-profile criminal hospitalized, when an important businesswoman is brought in. Mark suspects her security guard has deadly intentions.

videos.title: Slam-Dunk Dead
videos.overview: Jesse's new part-time job as trainer of the pro basketball Mustangs turns deadly when he's accused of murdering a star player.

videos.title: Looks Can Kill
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan investigates a plastic surgeon when an actress's death apparently results from an infection contracted during surgery.

videos.title: Fatal Impact (1)
videos.overview: Mark and Amanda are assigned to the task force investigating an airplane crash. An adversarial FBI agent and Russian mobsters make their assignment more difficult.

videos.title: Fatal Impact (2)
videos.overview: Steve and Ron lead the chase for the stolen nuclear material.

videos.title: Must Kill TV
videos.overview: The Sloans run into plenty of industry politics when they investigate the death of television network executive, Rachel Woodrall. Seamy revelations about Woodrall's college sorority lead to the killer.

videos.title: Discards
videos.overview: Jesse finally reunites with his father. After they narrowly elude an assassin, Jesse begins to realize his father isn't the accountant he's always claimed to be, but rather a spy. The Travis's attempt to discover who's sending the killers.

videos.title: A Mime is a Terrible Thing to Waste
videos.overview: A dead mime leads to an investigation of a crooked auto dealer. Randy Wolfe, a woman who's apparently an expert at everything, leads the investigation while continually annoying Steve.

videos.title: Down and Dirty Dead
videos.overview: A motorcycle stunt driver has a fatal accident while filming an action video. Steve investigates.

videos.title: Retribution (1)
videos.overview: When Steve is shot and falls into a coma, Mark does all in his power to find the assailant, even threatening a suspect with bodily harm. Mark finds himself the prime suspect when Steve's alleged attacker, Gordon Ganza, is murdered and all clues point directly towards Dr. Sloan.

videos.title: Retribution (2)
videos.overview: This episode takes place four months after Mark was convicted of murder. Steve is slowly recovering from his wounds and Mark is still rotting in prison. While Mark endures the taunts of fellow death row inmate Malcolm Trainor, Steve and Tanis Archer launch a rogue investigation to find Ganza's real killers.

videos.title: Drill for Death
videos.overview: A hospital emergeny preparedness drill turns deadly when an unpopular and ambitious nurse is found dead amid the chaos with an eccentric artist the only witness.

videos.title: Rain of Terror
videos.overview: A spat between a girl and her boyfriend leads to an apparent murder, leaving the girl and her mother with a dead body, just as dinner guests Mark and Amanda arrive. Panic sets in, when the body disappears, the power goes out, the roads are impassable, and the attacks begin.

videos.title: Baby Boom
videos.overview: A madman charges into a Lamaze class with a bomb, claiming that a fertility doctor was cheating him. Everything is complicated further when said doctor turns up dead.

videos.title: Talked to Death
videos.overview: Ratings seeking stunts by TV talk show hosts Darren & Mary has tragic results.

videos.title: An Education in Murder
videos.overview: When a rash of deaths at a high school revolve around one 'helpful' young girl, Dr. Sloan risks his own life to uncover the murderer.

videos.title: Murder at the Finish Line
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan investigates to find out who's behind the death of a driver in a speedway crash.

videos.title: First Do No Harm
videos.overview: When a young girl is rushed into the hospital in need of immediate treatment, but dies due to a HMO's negligence, Dr. Travis and Community General are sued for negligence. Dr. Sloan must choose between his ethical convictions and the hospital.

videos.title: Promises to Keep
videos.overview: The Matthews family is reunited after years apart. Here, Ryan and Tess Matthews come to LA to help Kate when she's in trouble with a con man.

videos.title: Food Fight
videos.overview: Dr. Travis gets involved in the treacherous and deadly trade of catering when he oversees the annual charity banquet.

videos.title: Obsession (1)
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan insists that a man he helped condemn to death for a series of bombings is guilty, even after a post-execution explosion.

videos.title: Obsession (2)
videos.overview: Three months after the execution of Lewis Sweeney, explosions are still rocking the LA area every four days. The unpopular Dr. Sloan continues his efforts to nail Carter Sweeney for the bombings.

videos.title: Resurrection (3)
videos.overview: Mark, Steve, Jesse, and Amanda are all trapped in the rubble of Community General in the aftermath of the bombing. Mark tries to shake off the numbing effects of the explosion in time to save Amanda, who's suffering from a punctured lung and broken collarbone. After the dust settles, the hunt for Caitlin Sweeney begins. It's discovered that the Sweeneys belong to a terrorist organization, R.O.A.R.

videos.title: Resurrection (4)
videos.overview: Carter and Caitlin kidnap Mark, forcing him to mastermind a 100 million-dollar theft. On the outside, Steve and Ron collaborate to find Mark. Meanwhile, Jesse and the Sloans buy a barbecue joint.

videos.title: Till Death Do Us Part
videos.overview: Two fiancées plot to murder the bride's father on their wedding day. The two review their perfect plan the night before the wedding. Unfortunately murder is never as easy as one might plan.

videos.title: Wrong Number
videos.overview: Mark stumbles onto a kidnapping case when the kidnapper accidentally calls the Sloan residence with a ransom demand. Steve runs to phone booths across the city a la Dirty Harry to safely rescue the child.

videos.title: Blood Will Out
videos.overview: The hospital is the scene of a manhunt when a corpse comes to life and attacks Amanda, then leads Steve and the police on a chase throughout the entire building during which he kidnaps Jesse's girlfriend Steve. Mark learns the fugitive is on the run from NSA agents, who claim he's an international terrorist.

videos.title: Alienated
videos.overview: Shadowy figures haunt Jesse after he returns after being missing five days and believes aliens may have abducted him. Mark and Steve try to figure out what happened to him, while Jesse tries to stave off hallucinations, clandestine midnight meetings, and secretive government agents.

videos.title: Write, She Murdered
videos.overview: When a best-selling mystery author comes down with writer's block, she commits a murder herself in the hopes of stimulating her creative juices. The delusional author has help from her fictional heroine, Danielle Slade.

videos.title: Rear Windows '98
videos.overview: Amanda enlists Jesse's computer-nerd friends to find a killer, after she accidentally surfs across an on-line murder. Meanwhile, Jesse's girlfriend, Susan, comes down with a case of food poisoning after dining at Barbecue Bob's.

videos.title: The Last Resort
videos.overview: Steve and his abrasive, confrontational partner are confined to a therapy home for 90 days after Steve shoots and kills a fleeing suspect. Steve's partner, Reggie, believes his wife and daughter are being held hostage by his nemesis, a belief that is furthered by a series of delusional events. On the outside, Jesse and Amanda work with Tanis Archer to solve the murder of a lab technician.

videos.title: Murder x 4
videos.overview: Steve investigates a series of seemingly unconnected murders committed by terminally ill patients, to find the hidden thread.

videos.title: Dead in the Water
videos.overview: Jesse's car breaks down while he and Susan are on their way to a fun-filled vacation in Carmel. The two are stranded in a small town where Susan spies a supposedly long dead beau, Greg. They eventually discover that he faked his death in order to plunder a shipwrecked vessel undetected. The townsfolk, all in on the scheme, murder Greg and pin the blame on Jesse and Susan.

videos.title: Trapped in Paradise
videos.overview: Steve goes undercover as a doctor in a private community after several mysterious deaths occur within its confines. Steve is 'aided' by a tabloid reporter posing as his wife.

videos.title: Voices Carry
videos.overview: Newly retired detective Harry Trumble returns to the force when it appears 'The Clown Killer', a murderer Trumble chased for more than a decade, has emerged from obscurity to kill again. Mark is reluctant to help Harry investigate the Clown, in part due to a rift between the two, but also because Mark suspects Harry has something to do with the Clown's reappearance.

videos.title: Murder, My Suite
videos.overview: Mark, Jesse, and Amanda are trapped in a hotel when it's quarantined after a deadly virus is released. They struggle to contain the virus, while at the same time trying to locate its origin. Meanwhile, a scheming seductress carries out her plan, using the virus as a diversion to rob a nearby bank vault.

videos.title: Murder on the Hour
videos.overview: A serial murderer strikes Community General every hour on the hour, choosing victims who've been seriously injured but 'brought back to life'.

videos.title: Rescue Me
videos.overview: Jesse saves a woman, Chloe, in a traffic accident that claims a jealous lover forced her off the road. Jesse looks out for his patient when her ex-boyfriend threatens her. Jesse rushes to Chloe's aid when her life is threatened by her boyfriend, and inadvertently kills him. Jesse finds himself the victim of Chloe's 'fatal attraction' as she pursues him voraciously. It gradually becomes clear that Chloe was the aggressor in her previous relationship.

videos.title: Down Among the Dead Men
videos.overview: A criminal with a death wish stalks Steve.

videos.title: Never Say Die
videos.overview: Steve enlists troubled teenager (he sure looked older than a teenager) Tommy to work as community service at a boxing club after too many brushes with the law. Tommy tries to control his temper. Mark finds that the club's sports drink is drugged, promoting aggressive tendencies in many of the boxers.

videos.title: Trash TV (1)
videos.overview: The Community General doctors are dragged back into the world of network television when producer Jackson Burley revamps the pilot for Dr. Danger, the television program based on Dr. Sloan. Mark and Steve investigate when Danger's competition, a masked magician who reveals the profession's secrets, is murdered, possibly as a ratings ploy.

videos.title: Trash TV (2)
videos.overview: Mark matches wits with a murderous network executive.

videos.title: Blood Ties
videos.overview: Absurdly bland episode lacks the usual Goldberg/Rabkin sizzle. Two female vice-officers uncover four corrupt female homicide cops who murder felons to harvest their organs for those more deserving.

videos.title: Today is the Last Day of the Rest of My Life
videos.overview: Dr. Sloan crusades to keep a physician-assisted-suicide advocate from practicing her trade.

videos.title: The Roast
videos.overview: A comedy roast in Mark's honor is ruined by a double murder.

videos.title: Sleeping Murder
videos.overview: Mark worries that his sleepwalking brother may be guilty of murder.

videos.title: Bringing Up Barbie
videos.overview: Mark baby-sits Barbie, the daughter of one of Steve's old friends, while her father hides from a gangster.

videos.title: Murder at Midterm
videos.overview: A fiendish med student sells prescription pads to a drug dealer and murders his partner when she becomes too needy. Mark plays Columbo to nail the murderer.

videos.title: The Flame
videos.overview: Steve investigates a murder in which the main suspect is the husband of Mark's old flame. Steve and Jesse date the same girl.

videos.title: The Killer Within
